blocks.text: An example of a letter of consent.

The Registrar of Trade Marks IP Australia PO Box 200 WODEN ACT 2606 Dear Sir: RE: Trade Mark Application No. 789999 in the name of XYZ TRACTOR COMPANY PTY LTD As owners of trade mark 1234567 ABCXYZ in Class 12, we hereby consent to the use and registration of the trade mark ABCXYZ filed under application 789999 by XYZ Tractor Company Pty Ltd in respect of “Tractors” in Class 12. Yours sincerely, Fred Y Smith FRED Y. SMITH DIRECTOR ABC MOTOR VEHICLE COMPANY PTY LTD
